text:
sara_sales: Heads-upTrident customer wants a private deploy behind their VPC. Netops asked: which connectivity pattern should we recommend, minimal ACL, how do source IPs behave, and an estimate for incremental network costs? Reply by EOD.
ali_netops: Short answer: recommend PrivateLink for auditability and simple private DNS. Recommend peering if they absolutely need source IP preserved without extra NAT.
ali_netops: Minimal ACL (paste-ready) - replace IPs with list we provide:
```
# Redwood service interface endpoints - allowlist
- proto: tcp; ports: 443; dest: 198.51.100.101/32  # redwood-privatelink-a
- proto: tcp; ports: 443; dest: 198.51.100.102/32  # redwood-privatelink-b
# optional: company resolver or route53 outbound
- proto: udp; ports: 53; dest: 10.10.0.2/32
```
sara_sales: Good. Also need a two-line blurb comparing costs & ops we can paste to their ticket.
ali_netops: Blurb: "PrivateLink: endpoint-hour + data processing per-GB (region dependent) but simpler ops and private DNS. VPC peering: no endpoint fee, but can add NAT/EIP and route-table ops to preserve src IPs across accounts; more complex for multi-AZ failover."
matt_se: Add ops caveat: if they do TLS inspection (MITM) on egress, SNI/cert interception will break our hostname routing and function calls. Ask for an allowlist or bypass for redwood hostnames.
julie_security: Security ask: we need to confirm if they require BYOK KMS integration or if Redwood-managed keys are acceptable, plus SOC2 evidence. We'll provide a short appendix for the security questionnaire.
legal_counsel: If they request contractual changes around SOC2 addendum or cross-border data flow, loop me in early.
ali_netops: Note on source IPs: with PrivateLink, traffic terminates at the interface endpoint; downstream calls from our infra will originate from Redwood IPs unless they forward through their NAT. With peering + customer-side 1:1 NAT the original client IP can be preserved.
sara_sales: Perfect. I'll send ACL + blurb to their netops. Ali, can you upload the /32 list and regional cost bullets to the ticket by 3pm? Julie/legal please DM any questionnaire/addendum snippets I can drop in the thread.
ali_netops: Will upload IP list + short cost table by 14:30.
julie_security: Will DM SOC2 checklist and KMS options by 15:00.
matt_se: Standby for the 16:00 call if they want deep dive on TLS behaviors.
sara_sales: Thanks all ":thumbsup:"
